evaluation.human_evals: The developer reports evaluations of GLM-4-9B-Chat on classic tasks, long-text ability via LongBench-Chat, six multilingual datasets compared with Llama-3-8B-Instruct, and the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard.
evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that GLM-4-9B and its human-preference-aligned version GLM-4-9B-Chat show strong performance across datasets covering semantics, mathematics, reasoning, code, and knowledge.

identity.name: GLM-4-9B-Chat
identity.summary: GLM-4-9B-Chat is the open-source chat version of the GLM-4 series, released by Zhipu AI.

input_output: Text input and text output for multi-turn dialogue
Long-text reasoning with up to 128K context
specifications.model_size: 17.5 GiB of safetensors weights (18,799,941,256 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: GLM-4-9B-Chat is described as a human-preference-aligned version of GLM-4-9B, and also supports multi-turn dialogue, web browsing, code execution, custom tool calls, and long-text reasoning with up to 128K context.
